cohort: 405 females, 18-35 years of age, in their 3rd trimester of gestation or post-natal period, without previous venous diseases or high-risk gestations, and without edema in other body parts, recruited from two hospitals in Rawalpindi, Pakistan between August 2018 and January 2019.
finding: Lower limb edema prevalence was 65.9%, particularly high in the third trimester, specifically months eight and nine, and significantly associated with months of pregnancy, exercises during pregnancy, and activity level.
followup_time: Through the postnatal period (exact duration not specified)
